title: Round state machine
prompt:
Write a ModuleScript that returns a RoundManager class. `RoundManager.new(durations)` where durations is
{ Intermission = number, Playing = number, Ended = number } (seconds). States cycle Intermission -> Playing ->
Ended -> Intermission, starting in Intermission. Methods: `:state(): string`; `:step(dt: number)` advances time by
dt seconds, and one big step may pass through several states (leftover time carries into the next state);
`:onChanged(fn)` registers fn(newState, oldState), called once for every state change, in order.
